# YouTube

> YouTube is a global video platform providing creator education, content management tools, community guidelines, and premium services like YouTube TV and NFL Sunday Ticket.

YouTube serves creators and viewers worldwide with comprehensive resources for channel growth, monetization, copyright protection, and content moderation. The platform emphasizes creator economy support, legal compliance, and community safety through transparent policies and educational content.

## Key Topics

- YouTube Partner Program
- Monetization
- Copyright Protection
- Content Management
- Community Guidelines
- YouTube Music
- Content ID Program
- Creator Education
- Digital Wellbeing
- YouTube TV
- NFL Sunday Ticket
- User Rights
- Press Releases
- Rightsholders
- Google Account

## Creator Resources & Education

- [YouTube Creators - Education & Inspiration for Video Creators](https://www.youtube.com/creators): Creator hub with education on channels, monetization, and audience growth
- [How YouTube Works: Giving Everyone a Voice](https://www.youtube.com/howyoutubeworks): Platform overview covering creator economy, safety, and global impact

## Content Management & Copyright

- [Copyright Tools: Rightsholders and Creators - How YouTube Works](https://www.youtube.com/about/copyright): Guide to YouTube copyright protection tools and content management
- [YouTube Policies Crafted for Openness - How YouTube Works](https://www.youtube.com/about/policies): YouTube community guidelines and content moderation policies

## News & Communications

- [Official YouTube Blog for Latest YouTube News & Insights](https://www.youtube.com/about/press): Official YouTube blog with news, creator profiles, and corporate announcements

## Premium Services

- [The Exclusive Home of NFL Sunday Ticket - YouTube & YouTube TV](https://tv.youtube.com/learn/nflsundayticket): YouTube TV and NFL Sunday Ticket sports streaming service information

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.youtube.com/t/contact_us): Contact information for YouTube support, press, and developer inquiries

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://www.youtube.com/t/terms): YouTube Terms of Service and legal user agreement
- [Privacy Policy – Privacy & Terms – Google](https://www.youtube.com/t/privacy): Google/YouTube privacy policy covering data collection and user rights
